payload.name: Include profile memories for joined classes and groups
payload.description: When asking what classes, courses, workshops, or groups a person has joined, enrolled in, or participates in, use profile memory kind alongside event/plan and count sign-ups as joined.
content: When the question asks about classes, courses, workshops, or groups a person joined, enrolled in, or participates in, do not restrict memory_kinds to event/plan; include profile memories too, since memberships and group participation are often stored as profile enrichments.
Treat 'signed up for', 'enrolled in', 'joined', or 'registered for' an activity as evidence of joining, even when it is scheduled to start in the future.
After retrieval, enumerate every distinct class/course/workshop/group named in any retrieved memory; do not omit a concrete one that appeared in results.

solves: When a question asks what classes, courses, workshops, or groups a person joined or participates in, agents often restrict searches to event/plan memories and miss profile-stored memberships, and may ignore a retrieved sign-up because it starts in the future. This rule generalizes to any membership/enrollment question: include profile memories and treat enrollments/sign-ups as joined, then enumerate every named class/group found.
